title: Contact
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 25.4 Linked Discourses 25.4
  • 1. Cakkhuvagga 1. The Eye

Samphassasutta Contact

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Cakkhusamphasso, bhikkhave, anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī; “Mendicants, eye contact is impermanent, decaying, and perishing. sotasamphasso … Ear contact, ghānasamphasso … nose contact, jivhāsamphasso … tongue contact, kāyasamphasso … body contact, manosamphasso anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. and mind contact are impermanent, decaying, and perishing.

Yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṁ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṁ vuccati ‘saddhānusārī …pe… Someone who has faith and confidence in these teachings is called a follower by faith. …” sambodhiparāyano’”ti.

Catutthaṁ.
